name: PolicyValue
stmt: def PolicyValue {m : ℕ} (π : E → Fin m → ℝ) (Q : Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a : Fin m, π θ a * Q a

name: fderiv_log_derivative_identity
stmt:
lemma fderiv_log_derivative_identity {m : ℕ} (π : E → Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E) (v : E) (a : Fin m)
    (hpos : 0 < π θ a) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v
      = (π θ a)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ v
proof:
by
                                                                   
  have hlog : HasFDerivAt (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a))
      ((π θ a)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) θ := by
    exact (hd.hasFDerivAt).log (ne_of_gt hpos)
  calc
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v
        = ((π θ a)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) v := by rw [hlog.fderiv]
    _ = (π θ a)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ v := by
          simp [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: policy_value_differentiable
stmt:
lemma policy_value_differentiable {m : ℕ} (π : E → Fin m → ℝ) (Q : Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E)
    (hd : ∀ a : Fin m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E => PolicyValue π Q x) θ
proof:
by
  unfold PolicyValue
  exact DifferentiableAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun a x => π x a * Q a) (x := θ) (by
    intro a ha
    exact (hd a).mul_const (Q a))

name: policy_gradient_vector
stmt:
theorem policy_gradient_vector {m : ℕ} (θ : E) (v : E) (π : E → Fin m → ℝ) (Q : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ a : Fin m, 0 < π θ a)
    (hd : ∀ a : Fin m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => PolicyValue π Q x) θ v
      = ∑ a : Fin m, π θ a * (fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v) * Q a
proof:
by
                             
  have hlog : ∀ a : Fin m, fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v
      = (π θ a)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ v := fun a =>
    fderiv_log_derivative_identity π θ v a (hpos a) (hd a)
                                                                
  have hsum : fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => PolicyValue π Q x) θ
      = ∑ a : Fin m, fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a * Q a) θ := by
    simpa [PolicyValue] using
      (fderiv_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun a x => π x a * Q a) (x := θ) (by
        intro a ha
        exact (hd a).mul_const (Q a)))
                                                                   
  have hitem : ∀ a : Fin m,
      fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a * Q a) θ v
        = π θ a * (fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v) * Q a := by
    intro a
                                                             
    have hfc : fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a * Q a) θ v
        = Q a * fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ v := by
      have hd' : fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a * Q a) θ = Q a • fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ :=
        fderiv_mul_const (hd a) (Q a)
      calc
        fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a * Q a) θ v
            = (Q a • fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) v := by rw [hd']
        _ = Q a * fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ v := by
              simp [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
                                                                          
    have hπ : fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ

name: fderiv_apply_direction_vector
proof:
by
                                                             
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • v) v 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add x
  have hf' : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f x) (x + (0 : ℝ) • v) := by
    have hx : x + (0 : ℝ) • v = x := by simp
    rw [hx]
    exact hf.hasFDerivAt
  exact (hf'.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hg).deriv.symm

name: policy_gradient_vector_directional
stmt:
theorem policy_gradient_vector_directional {m : ℕ} (θ : E) (v : E) (π : E → Fin m → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin m → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ a : Fin m, 0 < π θ a)
    (hd : ∀ a : Fin m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => PolicyValue π Q (θ + t • v)) 0
      = ∑ a : Fin m, π θ a * (fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v) * Q a
proof:
by
                       
  have hdir : fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => PolicyValue π Q x) θ v
      = deriv (fun t : ℝ => PolicyValue π Q (θ + t • v)) 0 := by
    exact fderiv_apply_direction_vector (policy_value_differentiable π Q θ hd)
  rw [← hdir]
  exact policy_gradient_vector θ v π Q hpos hd

name: policy_gradient_vector_clm
stmt:
theorem policy_gradient_vector_clm {m : ℕ} (π : E → Fin m → ℝ) (Q : Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E)
    (hpos : ∀ a : Fin m, 0 < π θ a)
    (hd : ∀ a : Fin m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E => π x a) θ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => PolicyValue π Q x) θ
      = ∑ a : Fin m, ((Q a * π θ a) • fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ)
proof:
by
                     
  ext v
  calc
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => PolicyValue π Q x) θ v
        = ∑ a : Fin m, π θ a * (fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ v) * Q a :=
          policy_gradient_vector θ v π Q hpos hd
    _ = (∑ a : Fin m, ((Q a * π θ a) • fderiv ℝ (fun x : E => Real.log (π x a)) θ)) v := by
          simp [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a ha
          ring

                                
                                                            
                                                   
                                              
                                                 
                                                             
                                       
                                       

section Softmax

variable {E : Type*}

name: SoftmaxPolicy
stmt: def SoftmaxPolicy {m : ℕ} (s : E → Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E) (a : Fin m) : ℝ
proof: Real.exp (s θ a) / ∑ b : Fin m, Real.exp (s θ b)

name: softmax_policy_pos
stmt:
lemma softmax_policy_pos {m : ℕ} (s : E → Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E) (a : Fin m) :
    0 < SoftmaxPolicy s θ a
proof:
by
  unfold SoftmaxPolicy
  have hnum : 0 < Real.exp (s θ a) := Real.exp_pos (s θ a)
  have hden : 0 < ∑ b : Fin m, Real.exp (s θ b) := by
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun b _ => Real.exp_pos (s θ b)) ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ a⟩
  exact div_pos hnum hden

name: softmax_policy_pmf
stmt:
lemma softmax_policy_pmf {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (s : E → Fin m → ℝ) (θ : E) :
    ∑ a : Fin m, SoftmaxPolicy s θ a = 1
proof:
by
  unfold SoftmaxPolicy
  have hden : (∑ b : Fin m, Real.exp (s θ b)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hn : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m)
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin m) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.1 hn
    exact ne_of_gt (Finset.sum_pos (fun b _ => Real.exp_pos (s θ b)) Finset.univ_nonempty)
  calc
    ∑ a : Fin m, (Real.exp (s θ a) / ∑ b : Fin m, Real.exp (s θ b))
        = (∑ a : Fin m, Real.exp (s θ a)) / ∑ b : Fin m, Real.exp (s θ b) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    _ = 1 := by
          exact div_self hden

end Softmax

end Lattice

name: proj_nonexpansive
doc:
到子空间 K 的正交投影是非扩张的（1-Lipschitz）：‖P x − P y‖ ≤ ‖x − y‖。
mathlib 依据：`orthogonalProjection` 是范数 ≤ 1 的连续线性算子
（`orthogonalProjection_norm_le`）⟹ `le_opNorm` 给出 1-Lipschitz。
stmt:
lemma proj_nonexpansive (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [HasOrthogonalProjection K] (x y : E) :
    ‖(orthogonalProjection K x : E) - (orthogonalProjection K y : E)‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hlin : (orthogonalProjection K x : E) - (orthogonalProjection K y : E) =
      (orthogonalProjection K (x - y) : E) := by
    rw [← Submodule.coe_sub]
    rw [← map_sub]
  rw [hlin]
  calc
    ‖(orthogonalProjection K (x - y) : E)‖ ≤ ‖orthogonalProjection K‖ * ‖x - y‖ := by
      simpa using (orthogonalProjection K).le_opNorm (x - y)
    _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
      calc
        ‖orthogonalProjection K‖ * ‖x - y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x - y‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (orthogonalProjection_norm_le K) (norm_nonneg (x - y))
        _ = ‖x - y‖ := by rw [one_mul]

name: proj_fixed
doc: 约束集内的点是不动点：x ∈ K ⟹ P_K x = x（`orthogonalProjection_eq_self_iff`）。
stmt:
lemma proj_fixed (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [HasOrthogonalProjection K] {v : E} (hv : v ∈ K) :
    (orthogonalProjection K v : E) = v
proof: (orthogonalProjection_eq_self_iff).2 hv

name: proj_top_identity
doc: 全空间投影是恒等：P_⊤ x = x。
stmt:
lemma proj_top_identity (x : E) :
    (orthogonalProjection (⊤ : Submodule 𝕜 E) x : E) = x
proof:
by
  rw [orthogonalProjection_eq_self_iff]
  trivial

                                           

variable {𝕜 E F : Type*}
  [RCLike 𝕜]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F]

name: GDUpdate_solution_fixed
doc: 最优解是 GDUpdate 的不动点：A x* = b ⟹ GDUpdate A b η x* = x*。
stmt:
lemma GDUpdate_solution_fixed (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (xStar : E) (hx : A xStar = b) :
    GDUpdate A b η xStar = xStar
proof:
by
  unfold GDUpdate
  rw [hx]
  simp

name: GDUpdate_sub
doc:
GDUpdate 的误差恒等式（E 侧）：任意 x y，GDUpdate x − GDUpdate y =
(1 − 2η·A†A)(x − y)（与 GD_error_identity 的 F 侧残差版对偶）。
stmt:
lemma GDUpdate_sub (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x y : E) :
    GDUpdate A b η x - GDUpdate A b η y =
      ((1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)) (x - y)
proof:
by
  unfold GDUpdate
  calc
    (x - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint (A x - b))) - (y - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint (A y - b)))
        = (x - y) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint (A x - b) - A.adjoint (A y - b)) := by
          rw [smul_sub]
          abel
    _ = (x - y) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ((A x - b) - (A y - b))) := by
          rw [← map_sub]
    _ = (x - y) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint (A x - A y)) := by
          rw [show (A x - b) - (A y - b) = A x - A y by abel]
    _ = (x - y) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • ((A.adjoint ∘L A) (x - y)) := by
          rw [← map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    _ = ((1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)) (x - y) := by
          simp [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]

name: GD_update_solution_error
doc: x* 最优时：GDUpdate x − x* = (1 − 2η·A†A)(x − x*)。
stmt:
lemma GD_update_solution_error (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x xStar : E)
    (hx : A xStar = b) :
    GDUpdate A b η x - xStar =
      ((1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)) (x - xStar)
proof:
by
  calc
    GDUpdate A b η x - xStar = GDUpdate A b η x - GDUpdate A b η xStar := by
      rw [GDUpdate_solution_fixed A b η xStar hx]
    _ = ((1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)) (x - xStar) :=
      GDUpdate_sub A b η x xStar

name: GD_contraction_solution
doc: 无约束 GD 步对最优解的收缩（E 侧谱界）：‖GDUpdate x − x*‖ ≤ c·‖x − x*‖。
stmt:
theorem GD_contraction_solution (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x xStar : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hx : A xStar = b)
    (hspec : ‖(1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖GDUpdate A b η x - xStar‖ ≤ c * ‖x - xStar‖
proof:
by
  rw [GD_update_solution_error A b η x xStar hx]
  calc
    ‖((1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)) (x - xStar)‖
        ≤ ‖(1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)‖ * ‖x - xStar‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ (x - xStar)
    _ ≤ c * ‖x - xStar‖ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hspec (norm_nonneg (x - xStar))

name: ProjGDUpdate
doc: 投影梯度更新：x' = P_K (GDUpdate A b η x)（约束集 K 的投影）。
stmt:
def ProjGDUpdate (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (K : Submodule 𝕜 E)
    [HasOrthogonalProjection K] (x : E) : E
proof: (orthogonalProjection K (GDUpdate A b η x) : E)

name: projGD_contraction_to_solution
doc:
投影梯度单步收缩到最优解：x* ∈ K、A x* = b、E 侧谱界 ⟹
‖x' − x*‖ ≤ c·‖x − x*‖。
stmt:
theorem projGD_contraction_to_solution (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ)
    (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [HasOrthogonalProjection K] (x xStar : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hxK : xStar ∈ K) (hx : A xStar = b)
    (hspec : ‖(1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖ProjGDUpdate A b η K x - xStar‖ ≤ c * ‖x - xStar‖
proof:
by
  unfold ProjGDUpdate
  calc
    ‖(orthogonalProjection K (GDUpdate A b η x) : E) - xStar‖
        = ‖(orthogonalProjection K (GDUpdate A b η x) : E) - (orthogonalProjection K xStar : E)‖ := by
          rw [proj_fixed K hxK]
    _ ≤ ‖GDUpdate A b η x - xStar‖ := proj_nonexpansive K (GDUpdate A b η x) xStar
    _ ≤ c * ‖x - xStar‖ := GD_contraction_solution A b η x xStar c hx hspec

name: ProjGDIterate
doc: 投影梯度迭代：x_{n+1} = P_K (GDUpdate x_n)。
stmt:
def ProjGDIterate (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (K : Submodule 𝕜 E)
    [HasOrthogonalProjection K] : ℕ → E → E
  | 0, x => x
  | n + 1, x => ProjGDUpdate A b η K (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x)

name: ProjGDError
doc: 投影梯度误差（平方）：e_n = ‖x_n − x*‖²。
stmt:
def ProjGDError (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (K : Submodule 𝕜 E)
    [HasOrthogonalProjection K] (x0 xStar : E) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar‖ ^ 2

name: projGD_iterate_contraction
doc: 迭代收缩：e_{n+1} ≤ c²·e_n（每步误差平方收缩 c²）。
stmt:
theorem projGD_iterate_contraction (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ)
    (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [HasOrthogonalProjection K] (x0 xStar : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hxK : xStar ∈ K) (hx : A xStar = b) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hspec : ∀ x : E, ‖(1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ProjGDError A b η K x0 xStar (n + 1) ≤ c ^ 2 * ProjGDError A b η K x0 xStar n
proof:
by
  intro n
  unfold ProjGDError
  have hstep : ‖ProjGDUpdate A b η K (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0) - xStar‖ ≤
      c * ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar‖ :=
    projGD_contraction_to_solution A b η K (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0) xStar c hxK hx
      (hspec (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0))
  have hsq : ‖ProjGDUpdate A b η K (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0) - xStar‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (c * ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar‖) ^ 2 := by
    exact sq_le_sq' (by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc0 (norm_nonneg (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar)),
        norm_nonneg (ProjGDUpdate A b η K (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0) - xStar)]) hstep
  calc
    ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K (n + 1) x0 - xStar‖ ^ 2
        = ‖ProjGDUpdate A b η K (ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0) - xStar‖ ^ 2 := by
          simp [ProjGDIterate]
    _ ≤ (c * ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar‖) ^ 2 := hsq
    _ = c ^ 2 * ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar‖ ^ 2 := by ring

name: projGD_converges
doc:
投影梯度收敛（ε-终止）：0 ≤ c < 1、E 侧谱界 ⟹
∀ ε > 0，∃ n，‖x_n − x*‖ < ε（接 RealConvergence.contraction_converges）。
stmt:
theorem projGD_converges (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ)
    (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [HasOrthogonalProjection K] (x0 xStar : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hxK : xStar ∈ K) (hx : A xStar = b) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hspec : ∀ x : E, ‖(1 : E →L[𝕜] E) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A.adjoint ∘L A)‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, ‖ProjGDIterate A b η K n x0 - xStar‖ < ε
proof:
by
                       
  have hc2_0 : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 := sq_nonneg c
  have hc2_1 : c ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have hlt : c * c < 1 * 1 := mul_self_lt_mul_self hc0 hc1
    nlinarith
                                                     
  have hconv :
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, ProjGDError A b η K x0 xStar n < ε :=
    contraction_converges (c ^ 2) hc2_0 hc2_1
      (projGD_iterate_contraction A b η K x0 xStar c hxK hx hc0 hspec)
      (fun n => by unfold ProjGDError; exact sq_nonneg _)
  intro ε hε
                                  
  rcases hconv (ε ^ 2) (sq_pos_of_pos hε) with ⟨n, hn⟩
                          
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 (le_of_lt hε) hn

name: projGD_unconstrained_recovery
doc: 无约束恢复：K = ⊤ ⟹ ProjGDUpdate = GDUpdate（投影梯度退化为普通梯度下降）。
stmt:
theorem projGD_unconstrained_recovery (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x : E) :
    ProjGDUpdate A b η (⊤ : Submodule 𝕜 E) x = GDUpdate A b η x
proof:
by
  unfold ProjGDUpdate
  simp [proj_top_identity]

name: prox_exists_unique
doc:
**一般 prox 的存在性与唯一性（一维）**：`f` 凸、连续、强制、`η > 0` ⟹
存在唯一的 `p` 使 `p` 极小化 `y ↦ f y + (1/(2η))‖y − x‖²`（即 `IsProx f η x p`）。
stmt:
theorem prox_exists_unique {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)
    (hcont : Continuous f)
    (hcoer : ∀ x, ∃ R, ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≥ R → f y > f x)
    {eta x : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) : ∃! p : ℝ, IsProx f eta x p
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hcoer x
  set M : ℝ := max R (‖x‖ + 1) with hM
  have hMR : R ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hMx1 : ‖x‖ + 1 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hxM : x ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M := by
    rw [Set.mem_Icc]
    have hMx : ‖x‖ + 1 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
    have hx_le : x ≤ ‖x‖ := le_abs_self x
    have hx_ge : -‖x‖ ≤ x := neg_abs_le x
    constructor <;> linarith
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => f y + (1 / (2 * eta)) * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2
  have hFcont : Continuous F := by
    have h1 : Continuous fun y : ℝ => ‖y - x‖ :=
      continuous_norm.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
    have h2 : Continuous fun y : ℝ => ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := h1.pow 2
    have h3 : Continuous fun y : ℝ => (1 / (2 * eta)) * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 :=
      continuous_const.mul h2
    exact hcont.add h3
  obtain ⟨p, _hp_mem, hp_min⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn ⟨x, hxM⟩ hFcont.continuousOn
  have hp_min' : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M, F p ≤ F y := isMinOn_iff.mp hp_min
  have hFx : F x = f x := by
    simp [F]
  have hglob : ∀ y : ℝ, F p ≤ F y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M
    · exact hp_min' y hy
    · rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or] at hy
      have hyR : R ≤ ‖y‖ := by
        rcases hy with h1 | h2
        · push_neg at h1
          have hyneg : y < 0 := by linarith [hMx1, norm_nonneg x]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_neg hyneg]
          linarith
        · push_neg at h2
          have hypos : 0 < y := by linarith [hMx1, norm_nonneg x]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hypos]

name: prox_exists
doc: **存在性（投影形式）**：`prox_exists_unique` 的存在部分。
stmt:
theorem prox_exists {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (hcont : Continuous f)
    (hcoer : ∀ x, ∃ R, ∀ y, ‖y‖ ≥ R → f y > f x) {eta x : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, IsProx f eta x p
proof:
(prox_exists_unique hconv hcont hcoer heta).exists
